Course: Software Engineering
Fall 2026 Syllabus
Major Project: Student Appointment Booking System
Due date: November 20, 2026
Weight: 30% of course grade
Instructions: Design and implement a working application for booking appointments. Include user stories, a data model, a working prototype, automated tests, and a short demonstration. Submit source code, test evidence, and a report. Teams should plan requirements, design, implementation, testing, and final presentation.
Other dates:
2026-11-03 - Requirements quiz
2026-11-10 - Design review
